title: Analyzing Sentiment Polarity Reduction in News Presentation through Contextual Perturbation and Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technique for reducing sentiment polarity in news reporting to mitigate media bias. While it uses the Citizenship Amendment Bill (CAB) as one of its evaluation topics—which involves religious groups—the paper's objective is to evaluate the technical performance of sentiment reduction methods (adversarial attacks and LLM prompting) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves.
